subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace `SKILL.md` diagnostics be accepted as a lint-first command, or must the complete fix also surface skipped candidates in normal skills list/check/status/Web flows before this issue closes?
rationale: Current main lacks any diagnostic surface, and the open PR provides a plausible lint command but may not cover every user-visible surface requested by this issue.

options.title: Lint-first plus follow-up
options.body: Land a corrected `skills lint` implementation as the first supported diagnostic surface, then keep or open narrower follow-up work for normal status/Web visibility.

options.title: Require full-surface diagnostics
options.body: Hold the implementation until skipped-candidate diagnostics are threaded through list/check/status/Web output and docs together.

options.title: Narrow to docs/support
options.body: Decline new runtime/status surfaces for now and document manual `SKILL.md` validation expectations only.

recommendation.title: Lint-first plus follow-up
recommendation.body: Land a corrected `skills lint` implementation as the first supported diagnostic surface, then keep or open narrower follow-up work for normal status/Web visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work connects the local loader, workspace loader, and gateway-backed skills CLI status path that define the likely implementation boundary.
